title: test_fleet_guards: guard regression fails as TimeoutExpired, losing case context; live-side-effect window unnamed
description: Security pass of 048n codereview (kimi-k3): scripts/test_fleet_guards_cycle_min.py:62-66 — if any REJECT_CASE is ever accepted (guard regression), subprocess.run(timeout=30) raises TimeoutExpired instead of returning, so the per-case 'why' context in _assert_rejected is lost; and before the kill the script runs one real loop iteration against the hardcoded production REPO (bd list + credits API GET, potential real bd create if fleet state trips an alarm). Fix: wrap the run in try/except subprocess.TimeoutExpired and assert failure with the case's why; name the live-side-effect window in the docstring rather than only implying it.
close_reason: Fixed: _assert_rejected in scripts/test_fleet_guards_cycle_min.py now wraps the run in try/except subprocess.TimeoutExpired and pytest.fail()s with full per-case context (why + value + explicit statement that the script entered the live guard loop). The known live-side-effect window (no dry-run mode in fleet-guards.sh: one real bd cycle + provider credits GET against the hardcoded REPO before the 30s kill) is named in the module docstring per the finding's fallback guidance. pytest 2/2 pass.
